title: Org admin airlock: IP allowlist, public-sharing ban, and data export locks
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Add an "airlock" layer of org-level admin controls that operators can toggle to enforce compliance constraints: strict IP allowlisting for management plane/API, a global disable for public sharing (links / guest sharing), and a configurable data export lock that blocks token/CSV/API-level offboard unless approved. These controls must integrate with RBAC v2 roles, emit high-fidelity audit logs, and respect SSO/SAML group mappings. Target: ensure enterprise customers can harden orgs for regulated workloads without custom forks.
acceptance_criteria: Org-level IP allowlist can be configured via Console and API and is enforced for all control-plane endpoints (login, admin API, console access)
A single ‘Disable public sharing’ toggle prevents creating shareable links and presented sharing UI for all resources (projects, prompts, evals) and is respected in SDK/API responses
Data export lock prevents all backup/download/export endpoints and UI flows; admins can add allowlist exceptions via a signed approval flow
RBAC v2 role mappings (admin, org-auditor, readonly) interact correctly with toggles; e.g., org-auditor sees audit logs but cannot bypass export lock
Every toggle change and every blocked export/share attempt is recorded in audit logs with actor, timestamp, source IP, action, and policy snapshot
Support SSO/SAML group sync so enforcement honors upstream group-to-role mappings during automatic provisioning
End-to-end e2e test covering: console toggle flip, policy enforcement, audit log emission, and role-based exception request
tasks: Design API surface for org-level compliance toggles (PATCH /v1/orgs/:id/settings) — include schema and validation
Extend RBAC v2 middleware to evaluate org toggles before allowing resource share/export endpoints
Implement IP allowlist enforcement in auth proxy and management API gateway with CIDR support and fallback behaviors
Wire Console UI: settings page with toggle states, rollout controls, inline risk notes, and ability to add temporary exceptions
Add audit logging hooks: policy-change events, blocked attempts, temporary exceptions issued/expired
Implement signed approval flow for export exceptions (audit trail, approver identities, TTL), integration with existing approvals service
SAML/SSO sync: ensure group -> role mappings are applied at login and re-evaluated when settings change
Create e2e test harness and regression tests, include simulated attacker IP to assert block behavior
Docs & runbook: admin docs on behavior and incident runbook for false positives and temporary access
Security review and threat model update (include privacy impact assessment for audit retention)
comments: 2025-02-19 Aisha Patel: Spiked API schema and proto for settings. Decided on single settings blob per org with per-feature metadata (enabled, enforcement_mode, audit_level). Linking design doc: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/SEC/Org+Airlock+Design
2025-02-22 Mateo Ruiz: Implemented middleware stub in runtime service. Noted potential perf impact for every request — will gate check to admin endpoints and high-risk export endpoints only.

2025-02-25 Security review (J. Huang): Suggested to avoid soft-fail behavior by default; must explicit opt-in to allowlist bypass for emergency offsets. Recommended signed approvals and RBAC audit retention for 180d.
2025-03-01 PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/1221 — adds API routes, migration for org_settings, and basic enforcement checks. Needs backend e2e and console wiring.

2025-03-03 Mateo Ruiz: Found edge case where SSO group mapping lag allows user created session to retain prior roles. Plan: re-evaluate role bindings at token refresh and on critical action when toggle state changes
2025-03-05 QA: Blocked export test failing intermittently in CI due to proxy caching. Workaround: invalidate cache on settings change. Action item assigned to ENG-84736 (proxy-cache-invalidation).
